input_messages.content: Hi! I'm having trouble sending MMS messages from my messaging app for the past few hours. I would like to get this fixed so I can send MMS messages again. Can you help me with that?
My phone number is 555-123-2002, and my name is John Smith. How can I assist you further?
I don't want to change my mobile data plan. I would like to refuel 2.0 GB of data, please.
I want to refuel 2.0 GB of data, but I haven't received a payment request yet. Could you please send me the payment request so I can proceed?
Yes, please go ahead and refuel 2.0 GB of data for me.
I confirmed to refuel 2.0 GB of data. Also, I turned on mobile data on my phone. What should I do next?
I will try to send an MMS message now.
I tried sending an MMS message, but it still didn't go through. I also checked, and my messaging app cannot send MMS messages. What should I do next?

The network status shows that airplane mode is ON, and my SIM card status is missing. There is no cellular connection or signal, and the cellular network type is none. Mobile data is enabled, but data roaming is off. Wi-Fi is also off and not connected. What should I do next?
I turned off airplane mode, but now my phone shows no signal and data is disabled. Also, it says no SIM card is detected in the phone. What should I do next?
I reseated the SIM card, and now it shows that the SIM card is active and working. The status bar indicates a poor signal with 2G network and mobile data enabled. What should I do next?
The network mode preference is set to 2G only. Since MMS requires at least a 3G connection, what should I do next?
I changed the network mode preference to 4G/5G preferred. Now my phone shows an excellent 5G signal with mobile data enabled. What should I do next?
I tried sending an MMS again, but it still cannot send. My messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. What should I do next?
The current APN name is set to "internet," but the MMSC URL for picture messages is not set. What should I do next?
I updated the APN settings to include the MMSC URL for picture messages. What should I do next?
I checked again, but my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. This is quite frustrating. What else can we try to fix this?
The APN name is "internet" and the MMSC URL is set to "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." What should I do next?
Wi-Fi Calling is currently turned ON. What should I do next?
I turned off Wi-Fi Calling, but my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. What else can we try?
The messaging app has permissions for "sms" and "phone," but it does not have permission for "storage." What should I do next?
I granted the storage permission to the messaging app, but it still cannot send MMS messages. This is quite frustrating. What else can we try?
I restarted the phone, and it shows an excellent 5G signal with mobile data enabled. However, my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. This is quite frustrating. What else can we try?
The speed test failed due to no connection, even though VPN is off and Data Saver mode is off. It seems mobile data is not working properly despite being enabled. What should I do next?
Airplane mode is OFF, mobile data is enabled, and data roaming is OFF. I am currently abroad in France, so I am outside my home network area. What should I do next?

I turned on data roaming on my phone. The speed test now shows an excellent connection with 275 Mbps download speed. I also checked, and my messaging app can now send MMS messages successfully. The issue seems to be resolved. Is there anything else I should do?

No, that's everything. Thank you very much for your help and patience in resolving this issue. Have a great day! 

###STOP###
